component.name: Button
component.description: Triggers an action. Four variants that name an absolute visual weight, not a rank (accent brand-fill, neutral bordered, transparent ghost, danger error-fill) — the container decides which weight an action gets (ADR-024). Three sizes, optional leading and/or trailing icon, icon-only shapes. Fully keyboard-accessible via the native button element.

useWhen: An action happens in place and the URL doesn't change: a form submits, a dialog opens, a panel expands
An icon-only control in a toolbar, table row or inline action group (set shape)

notFor.case: Using Button for navigation that produces a URL
notFor.because: Produces a <button> element; links that change the URL should be <a> elements for correct semantics and accessibility.

patterns.name: form-actions
patterns.description: Decision-region footer: one accent confirm with a neutral cancel.

patterns.name: destructive-confirm
patterns.description: Confirming a destructive action: danger replaces accent; cancel stays neutral.

patterns.name: card-actions
patterns.description: Actions inside a card or other repeated item: the lead action is neutral, the second transparent. Never accent — N cards would mean N primaries.
patterns.tree: Card > Stack(gap=md) > [Heading, Text, Inline(gap=sm) > [Button(variant=neutral, size=sm), Button(variant=transparent, size=sm)]]

patterns.name: hero-cta
patterns.description: A single large accent Button below a Heading and Text block.

useWhen.accent: The one action a decision region exists for: form or dialog footer, hero. Brand fill.
useWhen.neutral: Everyday and supporting actions, and the lead action in a card or other repeated item. Bordered.
useWhen.transparent: Low-weight actions inline with content ('Show more', Close) and a card's second action. No fill at rest.
useWhen.danger: Destructive or irreversible actions (delete, deactivate), next to a neutral Cancel. Error fill.

useWhen.sm: Dense UI: table rows, inline actions, toolbars.
useWhen.lg: Hero sections, prominent calls to action, touch-first flows.

useWhen.square: Icon-only actions in toolbars, table rows and inline groups. Small rounded corners.
useWhen.round: Floating actions or controls next to an avatar. Circular.

limits.because: Variants are absolute weights: the region's one decision gets accent, everything else neutral or transparent (ADR-024).
A card's lead action isn't the page's lead action; N repeated items would render N competing primaries. Use neutral, then transparent (pattern card-actions).

rules.case: Using accent or neutral for a destructive action
rules.because: Making delete look like the page's main call to action trains users to click it. Weight alone does not signal consequence.
rules.do: Use variant=danger, paired with a neutral Cancel (pattern destructive-confirm).

rules.case: Using a transparent or neutral icon button over an image or video thumbnail without a contrast treatment
rules.because: Both have no opaque background, so the glyph's contrast depends on whatever pixels are underneath and can drop to near zero on a light or busy photo. Hover tints do not fix it: there is no hover on touch, and contrast is judged at rest.
rules.do: The media-overlay treatment is owned by the parent molecule (ADR-009 rule 3): CardVertical's Favorite and Menu render variant=transparent with an icon.on-media glyph plus icon.on-media.halo drop-shadow. Reuse those parts rather than re-styling Button.
